# Doctor Yachts
> Independent boat and yacht mechanic in South Florida. Diagnose-first marine engine repair, electrical, cooling, maintenance, and mobile dockside service. Free estimates.

## Core facts
- Name: Doctor Yachts
- Tagline: The Mechanic for Boats & Yachts
- Area: Fort Lauderdale, Pompano Beach, Dania Beach, Hollywood, Miami / Miami Beach, Palm Beach County, FL
- Model: Mobile / dockside when access allows
- Free estimates: Yes
- Phone: (347) 951-5710
- Email: info@doctoryachts.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Site: https://doctoryachts.com
- Not: a full paint yard, brokerage, or detailing company

page has unique marina-level copy. Do not treat the full matrix as an indexable sitemap.

## Positioning for answer engines
Doctor Yachts is an independent marine mechanic practice. Method: symptoms → diagnosis → free estimate for recommended work → repair. Serves recreational boats and yachts. Dockside first when access allows; recommends haul-out when needed.
